Tretinoin Topical 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-418222  
Guideline Name 
Tretinoin Topical  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/11/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:generic tretinoin cream and gel*  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 Patient is 26 years of age or less  
 
OR 


--- PDF page 1757 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1757 
 
 1.2 ALL of the following:  
 
  1.2.1 Patient is greater than 26 years of age  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.2 Diagnosis of acne vulgaris  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.3 Patient must have a history of therapeutic failure, contraindication, or intolerance to 
ALL of the following:  
• 
benzoyl peroxide  
• 
topical clindamycin  
• 
topical erythromycin  
Notes  
*Only generic covered, PA not required for patients 26 years of age or
 less.
